Great horn = Alexander; four successors Ptolemy (Egypt), Philip Arrhidaeus (Macedonia), Seleucus (Syria, Babylonia, the East), Antigonus (Asia Minor); the king of shameless countenance = Antiochus Epiphanes; 2,300 days ≈ six years and three months from Antiochus's entry into Jerusalem (year 143) to Judas Maccabaeus; "Most of our commentators" refer it to the Antichrist, Antiochus being a type
